title: 2026-11-18_Remaiten_Botnet_Investigation_f55
description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a compromised network infected with the Remaiten botnet. Your goal is to identify and analyze the malicious activities performed by the botnet on the infected hosts. The botnet is known to perform command and control (C2) communication, lateral movement, and exfiltration of data.
outcomes: Identify suspicious services and their associated network ports.
Analyze systemd timers and services for persistence mechanisms.
Investigate unauthorized network communication and data collection activities.

levels.title: Suspicious C2 Beacon Service Discovery
levels.content: Security monitoring has detected an unusual network-facing component on the compromised host. Investigate the running services and identify the service responsible for sending beacon periodically to the C2 Server.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH with the provided credentials.
2. List all services to identify any suspicious or unfamiliar services.
   ```
systemctl list-units --type=service --all
```
3. Check the status of all services to find any unusual or suspicious services.
   ```
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=running
```
4. Look for services with unusual names or descriptions that might indicate malicious activity.
5. Identify the service responsible for sending beacon periodically to the C2 Server.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: An unfamiliar network service appears to be involved in unauthorized communication with an external system. Investigate the service and determine the network port associated with this communication.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH with the provided credentials.
2. Inspect the service configuration to find the network port associated with the C2 communication.
   ```
systemctl cat bot-beacon.service
```
3. Check the ExecStart line in the service configuration to identify the script responsible for the C2 communication.
4. Inspect the script to find the network port used for the C2 communication.
   ```
cat /usr/local/lib/.botcache/beacon.sh
```
5. Identify the network port associated with the C2 communication.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery for C2 Beaconing Service
levels.content: Investigators suspect how the C2 beacon service automatically resumes after the system starts and continues to execute periodically. Determine which system component is responsible for scheduling this activity.
levels.solution:
1. Connect to the bot1 host using SSH with the provided credentials.
2. List all timers to identify any suspicious or unfamiliar timers.
   ```
systemctl list-timers --all
```
3. Check the status of all timers to find any unusual or suspicious timers.
   ```
systemctl list-unit-files --type=timer
```
4. Look for timers with unusual names or descriptions that might indicate malicious activity.
5. Identify the timer responsible for scheduling the C2 beacon service.
